sevenEssenceAbility.name: Blitz Tactics
sevenEssenceAbility.effect: Until the end of the encounter or you are dying, each minion under your control during the encounter: the first time on a turn it moves through an enemy's space, the enemy chooses to shift 1 or be M < WEAK (M < AVERAGE if the minion is larger than the enemy) knocked prone; potency +1 for each subsequent minion moving through that enemy's space in the same move action.

ward.name: Conjured Ward
ward.atLevel3: Passive: +3 bonus to Stamina at 3rd level (increases by 3 at 4th, 7th and 10th). At level 3 the Stamina maximum rises by 3.

level2.staminaDerivation: 15 (V107 level-1 value = class Starting Stamina 15, class/summoner.md Basics) + 6 x 1 (Stamina Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels: 6, class/summoner.md Basics) = 21. No other kit/ancestry/career Stamina modifier: Summoner's Kit (feature/summoner/level-3/summoners-kit.md) grants only Summoner Strike changes and a ward; Human traits Determination and Can't Take Hold and the V107 career/culture carry no Stamina modifier.
level2.recoveriesDerivation: 8 unchanged from level 1: class Recoveries 8 (class/summoner.md Basics); no level-2/3 feature changes Recoveries.
level2.recoveryValueDerivation: floor(21 / 3) = 7 (rule/health/recoveries.md: 'one-third of their Stamina maximum, rounded down')
level2.windedValueDerivation: floor(21 / 2) = 10 (rule/health/winded.md: 'half your Stamina maximum'; rounding per rule/general/always-round-down.md: 'round the result down')
level2.conjuredWardDerivation: No ward before 3rd level (class/summoner.md advancement table: Summoner's Kit at 3rd).
level2.speedStabilityDisengageDerivation: Unchanged from V107 level 1. Summoner's Kit (feature/summoner/level-3/summoners-kit.md) lists no speed, stability, disengage or Stamina bonus; it is not one of the standard kits in kit/.
level2.summonersRangeDerivation: 5 + Reason 2 = 7 (feature/summoner/level-1/minions.md: 'Your Summoner's Range is equal to 5 + your Reason score'); Reason stays 2 until the 4th-level Characteristic Increase (class/summoner.md advancement table).

summonerStrike.damageDerivation: 'R damage' = Reason 2 (feature/ability/summoner/level-1/summoner-strike.md); Summoner's Kit not yet gained

level3.staminaDerivation: 15 (V107 level-1 value = class Starting Stamina 15, class/summoner.md Basics) + 6 x 2 (Stamina Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels: 6, class/summoner.md Basics) = 27; + 3 Conjured Ward (feature/summoner/level-3/conjured-ward.md: '+3 bonus to Stamina', increases only at 4th/7th/10th) = 30; a Stamina bonus is added to the Stamina maximum (chapter/kits.md#Stamina Bonus). No other kit/ancestry/career Stamina modifier: Summoner's Kit (feature/summoner/level-3/summoners-kit.md) grants only Summoner Strike changes and a ward; Human traits Determination and Can't Take Hold and the V107 career/culture carry no Stamina modifier.
level3.recoveriesDerivation: 8 unchanged from level 1: class Recoveries 8 (class/summoner.md Basics); no level-2/3 feature changes Recoveries.
level3.recoveryValueDerivation: floor(30 / 3) = 10 (rule/health/recoveries.md: 'one-third of their Stamina maximum, rounded down')
level3.windedValueDerivation: floor(30 / 2) = 15 (rule/health/winded.md: 'half your Stamina maximum'; rounding per rule/general/always-round-down.md: 'round the result down')
level3.conjuredWardDerivation: feature/summoner/level-3/conjured-ward.md: +3 at 3rd level; included in staminaMaximum and therefore in recoveryValue and windedValue, which both derive from the Stamina maximum.
level3.speedStabilityDisengageDerivation: Unchanged from V107 level 1. Summoner's Kit (feature/summoner/level-3/summoners-kit.md) lists no speed, stability, disengage or Stamina bonus; it is not one of the standard kits in kit/.
level3.summonersRangeDerivation: 5 + Reason 2 = 7 (feature/summoner/level-1/minions.md: 'Your Summoner's Range is equal to 5 + your Reason score'); Reason stays 2 until the 4th-level Characteristic Increase (class/summoner.md advancement table).

summonerStrike.damageDerivation: 2 x Reason 2 = 4 (feature/summoner/level-3/summoners-kit.md: 'increases to twice your Reason score')
summonerStrike.potencyDerivation: Average potency = Reason - 1 = 1 (class/summoner.md Basics 'Average Potency: Reason - 1'; rule/character/potency.md 'highest characteristic - 1' gives the same value because no witness has a characteristic above Reason 2); summoners-kit.md: 'potency ... increases to R < AVERAGE'
summonerStrike.distanceDerivation: summoners-kit.md: 'The distance of your Summoner Strike ability is now equal to your Summoner's Range' = 7. INTERPRETATION: the whole printed distance 'Melee 1 or Ranged 5' is replaced by Summoner's Range 7; alternative: only the ranged half changes ('Melee 1 or Ranged 7'). See uncertainties.
summonerStrike.slowedClause: The Effect's 'R < WEAK slowed (save ends)' clause is replaced by the kit's R < AVERAGE potency (interpretation: the kit raises that same potency).

uncertainties.question: How the Compendium ties the Summoner's Dominion fixture to a circle.
evidence: feature/summoner/level-2/summoners-dominion.md: 'call forth a piece of your portfolio's dominion like any minion' and 'summon a fixture from your minions' native manifold or origin' -- no fixture is named and no table maps circle or portfolio to fixture.
feature/summoner/level-1/portfolio.md table maps circle to portfolio: Blight->Demon, Graves->Undead, Spring->Fey, Storms->Elemental.

Each fixture lives only under monster/fixture/<family>/ with scc 'mcdm.summoner.v1/monster.fixture.<family>.featureblock/<name>', the same family names as monster/minion/summoner/<family>/; exactly one featureblock per family (demon: The Boil; undead: Barrow Gates; fey: Glade Pond; elemental: Primordial Crystal).

Trait text names the family for three of four: Barrow Gates 'Undead Dominion' ('your undead minions'); Glade Pond 'Overgrowth' ('your fey minions'); The Boil level-5 'Soul Rancor' ('your demon minions'), level-9 'Fester Field' ('non-abyssal'); Glade Pond level-9 'Folly Field' ('non-fey'); Barrow Gates level-9 'Open the Gates' references Rise!, a Graves 1st-level feature.
Primordial Crystal's text never mentions elementals; its only link to Storms is its monster/fixture/elemental/ path and scc.
uncertainties.ledgerPosition: Fixture = the single featureblock in the portfolio family directory. This rests on path/scc organisation plus the dominion wording, not on an explicit rule; no choice among fixtures is offered.

uncertainties.question: Does 'New Portfolio Minion' at 2nd level mean exactly one 5-essence minion?
evidence: feature/summoner/level-2/new-portfolio-minion.md: 'select new minions to add to your portfolio' (plural, no count, no cost named).

class/summoner.md advancement table Minions column: 1st '1, 1, 3, 3' -> 2nd '1, 1, 3, 3, 5' -> 3rd '1, 1, 3, 3, 5' -> 5th '1, 1, 3, 3, 5, 7'. One new entry, costing 5, is added at 2nd; nothing is added at 3rd.
uncertainties.ledgerPosition: INTERPRETATION: exactly one 5-essence minion from the circle's portfolio at 2nd level (read from the table's single added '5'). Alternatives considered: all three 5-essence minions of the family; an unspecified number. The feature text alone does not resolve this.

uncertainties.question: Does Conjured Ward's +3 affect winded and recovery values?
evidence: conjured-ward.md: 'You gain a +3 bonus to Stamina'.
chapter/kits.md 'Stamina Bonus': a kit's Stamina bonus 'is added to your Stamina maximum'; the ward is part of Summoner's Kit ('Your kit also comes with wards').
rule/health/recoveries.md: recovery value = one-third of Stamina maximum, rounded down; rule/health/winded.md: winded value = half Stamina maximum.
uncertainties.ledgerPosition: Derived: the +3 raises the Stamina maximum (27 -> 30 at level 3), so recovery value 10 and winded value 15 for Conjured Ward witnesses (v107-1, -5, -9). Residual doubt: the ward text says 'bonus to Stamina', not 'Stamina maximum'; applying the kits-chapter rule to a class-feature kit is an inference.

uncertainties.question: After Summoner's Kit, is Summoner Strike's distance 'Summoner's Range' only, or 'Melee 1 or Ranged <Summoner's Range>'?
evidence: summoners-kit.md: 'The distance of your Summoner Strike ability is now equal to your Summoner's Range.'
summoner-strike.md prints 'Melee 1 or Ranged 5' and a Special giving the Charge keyword 'when it's used as a melee strike'.
Lead by Example prints 'Melee 1 or Summoner's Range', a dual form.
uncertainties.ledgerPosition: Ledger records distance 'Summoner's Range' = 7 (literal reading). Alternative: melee 1 remains and only the ranged distance becomes 7. The Compendium does not settle whether the melee option (and its Charge Special) survives.
